fact: The digital chapter of the Programme d'Action du Gouvernement 2021-2026 sets out the project Transformation numérique des collectivités locales, led by the Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation and executed by ASSI, whose first expected result is that mairies and prefectures are connected to the Administration's network, with the connection of the communes to the RNA scheduled for 2023-2026 after studies in 2022, at a project cost of 21 billion FCFA: 8 billion from PPP, 7 billion from the national budget and 6 billion from KfW.
title: PAG 2021-2026, document 3 : Numérique
